about: Cube rankings (contract/cube-rankings-2026-10-21.md). Written by make_cases.py, the reference engine; iOS CubeRankingTests, web cubeRanking.test.ts and Android CubeRankingTest read it. Cards are indexed by sorted Oracle id. Replay each run's steps: before each step the engine's next screen for that session, from the log so far, must equal `question` (same cards, same order); then append `answer`. Estimates may differ by 1 (floating point).
